verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an interactive code editor, the Playground at playground.babylonjs.com, where you edit script and see the scene right away in the browser. It also lists the Inspector for runtime visual debugging and scene editing. This covers quick preview for snippets, but nothing documents hot reload in a real local project. missing for 10: documented hot reload or live script reload for local/npm projects, evidence of edit-run speed in full game codebases, independent hands-on corroboration of iteration speed.
